kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ارتقيت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَيْتُ (irtaqaytu) /ir.ta.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اِرْتَقَيْتَ (irtaqayta) /ir.ta.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اِرْتَقَيْتِ (irtaqayti) /ir.ta.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اُرْتُقِيتُ (urtuqītu) /ur.tu.qiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
